description: Proves that one signature is on a petition's public ledger and in Bitcoin, from the signature hash on the signer's receipt (64 hex characters). Walks the Merkle path itself, so the answer does not rest on Rotten America's word. Only the signer has their receipt hash; never ask for or guess anyone's personal details.

receipt_hash.description: The signature hash printed on the signer's receipt.

slug.description: The petition's slug, from find_petitions, my_petitions or start_petition.

name: prove_signature
title: Prove one signature is counted
